# Deployment manifest with flow collections and scalars of every style.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: notes-api
  labels: {app: notes, tier: backend, "team/owner": docs}
  annotations:
    checksum/config: 3f2a9c
    description: "Serves notes; see https://example.test/docs#api"
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: notes}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: notes, version: "1.8"}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: example.test/notes-api:1.8.2
          args: ["--port", "8080", --verbose]
          ports: [{containerPort: 8080, protocol: TCP}, {containerPort: 9090}]
          resources:
            requests: {cpu: 0.25, memory: 128Mi}
            limits: {cpu: 1, memory: 512Mi}
          env:
            - {name: MODE, value: production}
            - name: GREETING
              value: >-
                Hello from the notes service,
                folded onto one line.
            - name: SCRIPT
              value: |
                #!/bin/sh
                echo "not a comment: # inside a block"
                exit 0
            - name: WEIRD
              value: "tab\tand newline\n escapes, plus \\ backslash"
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /ready, port: 8080}
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata: {name: notes-config}
data:
  limits.json: '{"max": 100, "burst": 20}'
  feature.enabled: "true"
  ratio: 0.5
  sizes: [1, 2, 3, 5, 8]
  mixed: [1, two, 3.0, "four", {five: 5}]
  nested: {outer: {inner: [a, b, {deep: yes}]}, flag: off}
  bools: [true, False, YES, no, On]
  negative: -12
  version_list: 1.2.3
  comma, key: value
  plain: this has # a comment after a space
  hashy: value#not-a-comment

%YAML 1.2
# Service catalog for the staging cluster.
---
version: 3
updated: 2026-04-18T09:30:00Z
owner: "platform team"
contact: 'ops@example.test' # rotates weekly
enabled: true
maintenance: off
replicas: 3
ratio: -0.75
budget: 1,250.50
timeout_ms: 1500
empty_value:
nothing: ~
explicit_null: null

defaults: &defaults
  image: registry.example.test/base:1.4
  restart: unless-stopped
  env: &default_env
    LOG_LEVEL: info
    COLOR: "#00ff88"
    FEATURE_FLAGS: [search, "dark mode", beta]
  limits: {cpu: 500m, memory: 256Mi, pids: 64}

services:
  web:
    <<: *defaults
    image: registry.example.test/web:2.1
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
      - 8443:443
    env:
      <<: *default_env
      LOG_LEVEL: debug
      GREETING: 'it''s alive'
      QUOTE: "she said \"hi\" twice"
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD, curl, -f, "http://localhost/health"]
      interval: 30s
      retries: 5
  worker:
    <<: *defaults
    command: >
      python -m worker
      --queue default
      --concurrency 4
    depends_on: [web, cache]
    scale: 2
  cache:
    image: redis:7
    command: |
      redis-server
        --save 60 1
        --maxmemory 64mb
    volumes:
      - cache-data:/data   # persisted
      - ./conf/redis.conf:/usr/local/etc/redis/redis.conf:ro

volumes:
  cache-data: {}

matrix:
  - {os: linux, arch: amd64, primary: yes}
  - {os: macos, arch: arm64, primary: no}
  - [windows, amd64]
  - name: nested list item
    tags:
      - a
      - b

notes: |-
  Deploys happen on weekdays only.
  Keys like url: http://x.test/#anchor stay text.
folded: >+
  one
  two

tags:
  source: !!str 12345
  custom: !vault encrypted-blob
  url: http://example.test/path#fragment
  path: C:\tools\bin
"quoted key": value
'single key': 42
? complex key
: complex value
key with spaces: and a value with: colons
...
---
# Second document: a small workflow.
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, 'release/**']
  pull_request: {}
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        node: [18, 20]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install
        run: npm ci --no-audit
      - name: Test
        run: |
          npm test -- --coverage
          echo "done: ${{ job.status }}"
        env:
          CI: true
          RETRIES: 3
...
